subject: MongoDB Buys Firebolt 🍃, Playing GTA 2 via Airflow 🎮, LinkedIn Rebuilds Data Lineage 🧵
notes: Mostly engineering articles and tools. One acquisition (no price stated). Sponsor blocks (Toptal, J.P. Morgan, Oracle) ignored.

stories.headline: MongoDB acquires Firebolt and will run its analytics engine alongside the database
stories.quote: MongoDB has acquired Firebolt and will run its analytics engine alongside the database, kept in sync automatically so there is no pipeline to build.

facts.text: MongoDB presents the deal as removing the data-movement tax for agent-driven concurrent queries on fresh data.
facts.quote: MongoDB pitches it as removing the data-movement tax, since agents can drive thousands of concurrent queries and need sub-second answers on fresh data.

facts.text: Firebolt's engine will join search, vector search and Voyage AI models in MongoDB's platform.
facts.quote: It will join search, vector search, and Voyage AI models in the platform.

stories.headline: Open-source DocumentDB 1.0 reaches general availability
stories.quote: DocumentDB 1.0 brings an MIT-licensed, MongoDB-compatible document store to PostgreSQL through an extension and protocol gateway, letting existing drivers and queries work with a familiar relational foundation.
stories.description: MIT-licensed, MongoDB-compatible document store for PostgreSQL

facts.text: The GA release covers PostgreSQL 15-18 and adds a Kubernetes operator.
facts.quote: The GA release covers PostgreSQL 15-18, adds a Kubernetes operator, and focuses on stability across indexing, aggregation, and geospatial queries.
